name: A later wreck on the Dreadmurk Shore

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Aden sends the investigator to examine Defias survivors and wreckage.
description: The original chain and the patch 2.3 continuation are presented as separate historical evidence, joined here by editorial order rather than an asserted quest dependency. Lieutenant Aden reports Defias survivors near a shipwreck on the Dreadmurk Shore and sends the investigator to Captain Wymor at Sentry Point. The report opens a new inquiry: if the wreck is theirs, what did the Defias carry, and why were they searching its scattered remains?
